scope: Six assigned source objects only; issuer/form/report-period/CIK/source pointers and structural counts. No financial question, reference, answer or program files; no native model outputs; no new QA; no network. This is not a benchmark/admission certificate or independent human annotation.

parser.method: Verify exact source length/SHA256/git blob SHA1 against capture receipt before parsing. Extract only ten whitelisted DEI identity concepts, title, schema/CIK/link metadata; count structural tags without reading financial values. Inline visibility checks inspect ix:header/ix:hidden, ancestor inline display:none/visibility:hidden and hidden attributes.
parser.counts_definition: Raw parsed DOM tag counts include hidden elements and presentation/layout tables; zero th tags does not establish missing visual headers. DOM XPath is a parser locator, not a byte/page/bbox locator.

records.visibility_assessment: Issuer name, document type, report-period end date, file number and trading symbol are outside ix:header/ix:hidden and have no checked hidden ancestor; CIK, fiscal-year/period focus and amendment flag are inside ix:hidden under a display:none ix:header. This is markup inspection, not browser rendering.

summary.pair_interpretation: Internal identity metadata supports same-issuer successive fiscal-year reports. Each is labelled 10-K with hidden AmendmentFlag=false. This does not establish revisions of the same assertion, restatement history, or evidence requirements for any question.

limitations: Identity metadata is internal to mirrored released HTML; authentic original SEC correspondence and first-public availability were not verified.
No rendered visual review, external CSS evaluation, HTML-to-PDF fidelity test, semantic table extraction or completeness check was performed.
Structural counts cannot establish usable evidence tables, preserved row/column bindings, page/bbox alignment or comparison sufficiency.
AmendmentFlag=false describes these captured instances; it does not establish the absence of later amendments or restatements.
All inspected source groups are exposed development material.
